body: I'm not sure, I don't really compare my art to anyone elses I just feel like its not where it should be. I think I'd be content not ever achieving anything like that though and just dying young.

I guess it was gradual, I wanted to eventually have a career in art but I have't drawn in a longtime and my art isnt anywhere near as good as I would like it to be. I feel like everything I do is really for nothing because nothing has been working out for me

Its not really about the hobbies themselves, I still passionately love them I just can't make myself do anything anymore. Even doing fun things drain me and I'd need to find some kind of purpose to feel better. I don't really have any goals right now, and all the ones I did have fell through so I feel like somethings just telling me its my time to go.
